title: Expand Launch backend preflight panel
summary: Expand the Launch backend preflight evidence table and detail blocks so the Settings Check panel shows the loaded rows and selected-row detail without inner vertical scrolling.
reason: The Launch Settings Check preflight panel clamps the backend preflight table and detail block with shared evidence styles, hiding visible content behind nested scrollbars even for short preflight result sets.
behavior_before: The backend preflight table used the shared detail-table max height and the selected-row detail used the shared prose-block max height, causing scrollbars inside the Settings Check panel.
behavior_after: The backend preflight summary, table, and selected-row detail in the Launch Settings Check panel can grow to show their content naturally while preserving backend-owned launch/preflight behavior.
